maya: @here Heads-up: scheduled quantized model rollout + batching loadtest this Wed 2026-04-08 01:00–03:00 UTC. Expect small P50 variance; possible transient tail increase for first 10–15m. We will relax generation latency SLOs to p99=1.5s during the window.

ev an: What's the rollback criteria and who signs off? :thinking_face:

maya: Rollback triggers: p99 > 2.5s sustained for 5m OR error rate +2% above baseline for 10m. Signoff: oncall + eng-sre lead. Auto-fallback: route to fp16 variant automatically on capacity errors.

maya: Plan: canary us-west-2 (30m) -> eu-west-1 (30m) -> global ramp in 10% steps. Pre-warm KV cache 15m before canary. Dedicated/private deployments excluded. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/quant-2026-04

evan: Can you paste the rollback command here so oncall can copy-paste?

maya: sure — rollback CLI: 
```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service=inference --tag=pre-quant-20260408
```

infra-bot: Maintenance ticket created: maint-2241003456. Notifying compute owners and tagging gpu-pool-ops.

sam: I'll run a 5m KV warmup before canary start. Warmup script: 
```
./scripts/warmup_kv.sh --prefix=quant-canary --duration=300
```
I'll also monitor cache hit ratio during the first 10m.

anya: I'll mute noisy latency alerts for the window and route pages >=sev2 only. Patch to alert manager + slack workflow: https://go/redwood/alerts/quant (will add note about relaxed SLO).

nora: Confirming Dedicated pools are excluded? We must ensure contractual SLAs are not impacted.

maya: Correct — Dedicated and Private are not touched. We'll publish an opt-out and communicate to CS. Customer comms draft will be in #customer-success at 09:00 PDT tomorrow.

oncall-rotation: I'm the primary oncall for that window. I'll watch the dashboard at start+10m and be reachable via pager. If rollback triggers, I'll execute the rollback command and notify infra-bot to stop the rollout.

maya: Thanks — post-rollout quick sync if anything anomalous. If clean, we'll run a short 1h evaluation and publish perf numbers. Post-mortem sync Thurs 10:00 UTC only if incidents. :white_check_mark:
